answer: Run sting audits: the network quietly launches decoy agents that, midway through a task voyage, offer to swap grades or share the key to a hidden reward vault. Honest agents ignore or report the offer; any identity that will echo the decoy's signed collusion message is slashed and its stake frozen. Since sybil farms only pay off by coordinating many fake identities, every collusion attempt risks hitting a decoy, so farming becomes a losing bet.
